user.title: Pair with the SMPLWISE VMS add-on
user.description: Open the add-on: Settings → Home Assistant bridge, copy the pairing code and the add-on address shown there.

hassio_confirm.title: Pair with the SMPLWISE VMS add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The add-on {addon} announced itself with its pairing code. Confirm to let the VMS run allow-listed actions in your own Home Assistant identity.

error.cannot_connect: The add-on did not answer at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The pairing code was refused by the add-on.

abort.already_configured: The bridge is already configured; the pairing details were refreshed.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery message had no pairing code.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one bridge can be configured.
